name: Necromancer: the Hidden Lich Form wardrobe incarnation keeps the normal model (#8221)
contract: AppearanceCategories.dbc category 67 'Necromancer Lich Form' is APPEARANCE_TYPE_INCARNATION kind 4, class mask 4194304 (class 23). Appearances.dbc row 211705 names it with field 8 = -500981.

Lich Form 500981 casts the passive 504691 (MOD_SHAPESHIFT form 50), which supplies the Lich display through Unit::GetModelForForm. With the Hidden Lich Form incarnation selected and collected, Lich Form must keep the character's own model instead; clearing the selection restores the stock Lich display.
Only Lich Form (form 50, category 67) is wired; the sibling Pyromancer Draconic Form category is out of scope for this report.

steps.label: SETUP: the Lich model aura is applied
SETUP: the stock Lich display replaces the native model
Select the Hidden Lich Form incarnation while already shapeshifted
The normal model returns at once
Leaving the form removes the model aura
The character keeps its own model after unshifting
Clear the Hidden Lich Form selection
Lich Form with the selection cleared
SETUP: the Lich model aura is applied again
The stock Lich display returns once the selection is cleared
